searches.description: List of DNS search domains for host-name lookup

ports.description: Ports to expose by the service when using the NodePort type. Values need to match the port name of the service

cert.description: controls how the chart handles the proxy-cert TLS secret and the uyuni-ca ConfigMap.

takeOwnership.description: opts in to rendering proxy-cert and uyuni-ca even when objects with those names already exist in the namespace and were NOT created by helm. The default (false) leaves pre-existing objects alone so install/upgrade does not fail and the chart never silently overwrites something it did not create.  Set to true together with `helm install --take-ownership` (helm 3.14+) to let helm adopt the existing objects. Once adopted, value changes are applied on upgrade and the objects are removed on helm uninstall.
takeOwnership.title: takeOwnership

cert.title: cert

dnsConfig.description: Pod DNS configuration (Kubernetes PodDNSConfig). Omitted by default so the pod uses the cluster's normal DNS behavior. Tip: if external FQDN lookups from the proxy time out (10s urlopen), the cluster's default ndots:5 is likely the cause — override with:   dnsConfig:     options:       - name: ndots         value: "1"
